reason: Stream W changes how a provider request is estimated and what replayed reasoning it carries: context.replay_wire_form and estimate_model_request_parts (replayed tool history in adapter shape, reasoning text once, no bookkeeping); context.calibrated_request_estimate (text calibrated, JSON never below its estimate) used by ChatService._with_tool_history (target/watermark/newest checks), _fits_request_capacity, _ensure_request_capacity and the final-answer error; and the reasoning budget (_budgeted_reasoning keeping the route/model stamp, PreparedChat.reasoning_dropped, chat.tool_history.reasoning_dropped) in _with_tool_history, _cleared_tool_history_retry and _compacted_rejected_tool_request. Selected: the new test_replay_estimates.py; every adapter's reasoning and signature replay (test_reasoning_replay, test_prompt_caching, test_gemini_call_ids); in-turn replay, clearing, checkpoint and mid-turn fitting (test_turn_prompt_cache, test_in_turn_context_pruning, test_midturn_compaction, test_tool_history_memory, test_chat_tool_loop, test_routing_prose_answer, test_synthesis_tool_declarations, test_chat_routing_tolerance, test_tool_failures, test_chat_final_synthesis_recovery, test_restart_recovery_lifecycle, test_turn_outcome_history); estimates, calibration, capacity checks and context assembly (test_context, test_chat_context_assembly, test_api_stream_context, test_conversation_search, test_chat_reference_material, test_chat, test_chat_api, test_precompaction, test_turn_preflight_latency); goal budgets fit requests by the estimate (test_chat_goals). Counts from pytest --collect-only.
exclusions: No frontend, native or Playwright tests: no ui/ or Rust changes and nothing visible (the Working context meter reads the same fields). Provider adapter payloads are unchanged, so provider-adapter request tests beyond reasoning/signature replay and prompt caching are excluded; harness chats and missions do not use the chat replay or these capacity checks. Real-Core evidence (scratch Core, adapter-boundary captures, OpenRouter deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash 9K/12K turns before and after, anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5 reasoning turn) and the retention eval s2 repeat 3 on main and on this branch are in the PR body. No full suite.
